mechanism_state.mechanism: Substituting clean energy for fossil fuels — energy is substituted from an external clean source rather than being created from nothing, so no conservation law is broken.
mechanism_state.intervention: Replace the "single glass of water forever" claim with a clean-energy vehicle architecture: water/hydrogen is only a carrier, and the required energy is supplied externally (renewable-charged battery or electrolysis powered by solar/wind), with all inputs metered.
mechanism_state.expected_effect: The claimed infinite mileage is removed; vehicle range becomes a bounded function of measured external energy input, satisfying the first and second laws of thermodynamics.
